note: IEF Table View Mode adds a field widget plugin inline_entity_form_complex_table_view_mode (extends IEF Complex, applies to entity_reference/entity_reference_revisions) whose referenced-entities table columns come from a dedicated ief_table view mode (id <entity_type>.ief_table, label 'Inline Entity Form Table'), auto-created when a form display using the widget is saved. Requires inline_entity_form. No settings form/configure route/permissions/Drush. Config-only evals grounded in the real widget id and the ief_table view display. Introspection reads the configured widget type and the ief_table columns; execution sets the widget on a field and builds the ief_table view display. Field/view-display deletes are used (not node deletes) so they are safe on this shared site.

evals.prompt: In Drupal, I'm using the Inline Entity Form module and want the inline referenced-entities table to show more than one column. Which field widget does the ief_table_view_mode module add that I should select for my entity_reference field?
evals.expected_output: Select the 'Inline entity form - Complex - Table View Mode' widget (plugin id inline_entity_form_complex_table_view_mode) on the entity_reference field's Manage form display. It extends IEF Complex and drives the table columns from the ief_table view mode.

evals.prompt: The ief_table_view_mode module lets you choose which fields appear as columns in the Inline Entity Form table. Which view mode does it use, and what is that view mode's machine-name suffix?
evals.expected_output: It uses a view mode named 'Inline Entity Form Table' whose machine name is <entity_type>.ief_table (e.g. node.ief_table). It is auto-created when you save a form display that uses the table-view-mode widget. Configure that view mode's Manage display on the referenced bundle to pick the columns.

evals.prompt: With ief_table_view_mode set up on an entity_reference field, how do I control exactly which fields show up as columns of the inline entity form table for the referenced entities?
evals.expected_output: Edit the referenced bundle's 'Inline Entity Form Table' (ief_table) view mode display in Manage display: every visible field/extra-field configured there becomes a column, ordered by weight. Fields not placed in that display are not shown as columns.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an entity_reference field named field_ieftvm_m1 whose form widget uses the IEF Table View Mode feature. Inspect the live default form display for Article and give the exact widget type (plugin id) configured for field_ieftvm_m1.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_ieftvm_m1 component has type: inline_entity_form_complex_table_view_mode.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has an 'Inline Entity Form Table' (ief_table) view mode display configured. Inspect that display and name a field that has been placed as a column in it.
evals.expected_output: The core.entity_view_display.node.article.ief_table display is enabled and has the 'body' field configured as a visible column.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has an entity_reference field field_ieftvm_h1 (target Node) using the plain autocomplete widget on the default form display. Using ief_table_view_mode, change that field's default form-display widget to the IEF Table View Mode widget and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_ieftvm_h1 component type in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default to inline_entity_form_complex_table_view_mode and save (e.g. $fd->setComponent('field_ieftvm_h1', ['type'=>'inline_entity_form_complex_table_view_mode', ...])->save()). Saving also auto-creates the node.ief_table view mode.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is no Inline Entity Form Table (ief_table) view mode display for Article yet. Create and enable the node.article.ief_table view display and add at least one field (e.g. the title or body) as a visible column, applying it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create an entity_view_display for node/article/ief_table with status TRUE and at least one visible field component (e.g. body via setComponent), then save. Its visible components become the IEF table columns.
